notes: VAT 20% standard (PwC); no VAT on supply/import of investment gold (VAT Act Art. 36b). GAGA (Novi Sad), 27 Nov 2026: own spot 12,579.50 RSD/g; Argor-Heraeus sell vs spot: 1 g 15,808 RSD (+25.7%), 10 g 133,410 (+6.1%), 100 g 1,302,463 (+3.5%). Buyback is 12,578 RSD/g for all sizes = 4.7% under the 1 oz sell price (410,732 RSD). Duty and making null.

sources.name: PwC Tax Summaries - Serbia, Corporate - Other taxes
sources.what: The standard VAT rate is 20% for most taxable supplies (10% reduced for listed basics); customs duty rates under the Law on Customs Tariff range 0% to 57.6% with no gold-specific rate stated.

sources.name: Law on Value Added Tax (Zakon o PDV), Art. 36b - Investment gold (statute text)
sources.what: Art. 36b defines investment gold (bars/plates >= 995/1000 fine; coins >= 900/1000 minted after 1800) and states: 'PDV se ne placa na promet i uvoz investicionog zlata' - VAT is not payable on supply or import of investment gold, so gold vatBullionPct 0.
